items.title: 23.1 Drug discovery and development process (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of pharmacology and drug discovery (PDF 208).

blocks.text: Pharmacology hayatiyat ki woh shaakh hai jo dawaon aur jandaron par un ke asraat ka mutala karti hai: un ke zaraye, khasiyatein, tarkeeb, ilaaj mein istemal aur jism par asar. Dawaen kimiyai maadde hain jo bimariyon ki tashkhees, bachao ya ilaaj mein use hote hain. Yeh qudrati zaraye, paudon, janwaron aur khurdbeeni jandaron, se aa sakti ya laboratories mein banayi ja sakti hain; paudon se bani dawaen, jo riwayati tareeqa-e-ilaaj mein use hoti hain, jari booti ki dawaen (phytotherapy) kehlati hain.

Drug discovery aur drug development mehfooz aur mo'assar dawaen banate hain. Amal bimari paida karne wale targets ki pehchan aur un par asar karne wale compounds banane se shuru hota hai. Awaam ke liye manzoori se pehle dawa hifazat, asar aur miyaar ke kai marhalon ki jaanch se guzarti hai, aur sciencedan, mahireen aur regulatory idare saath kaam karte hain.

blocks.alt: Do hisson ka khaaka. Drug discovery: 1 Target identification, 2 Target validation, 3 Lead compound identification, 4 Lead optimization. Phir Drug development: 1 Preclinical research (in vitro aur in vivo), 2 Clinical trials (Phase 1: 20-100, Phase 2: 100-300, Phase 3: 1,000-3,000), 3 FDA drug review (approve or reject), 4 Manufacturing and marketing, 5 Post-marketing surveillance; har qadam ke darmiyan teer.
blocks.caption: Dawa ki daryaft (discovery) aur tayyari (development) ke qadam (asal khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi, sirf Roman Urdu ke liye).

blocks.prompt: Dawa ke qudrati aur masnooi zariye mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Qudrati dawaen paudon, janwaron ya khurdbeeni jandaron se aati hain; masnooi dawaen laboratories mein kimiyai tayyari se banti hain.

items: Pharmacology: dawaon aur un ke asraat ka mutala.
Dawaen tashkhees, bachao ya ilaaj; qudrati ya masnooi; jari booti ka ilaaj phytotherapy.
